subject: Northstar renewal: starter playbook, risk acceptance & QBR windowing
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@northstar.tech>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Northstar renewal: starter playbook, risk acceptance & QBR windowing

Alex —

Thanks for the time last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off the renewal thread and surface the starter playbook so we can align timelines and any outstanding risk/compliance asks before the QBR. High level ask: confirm whether Northstar is comfortable with the proposed term change (move from 12-mo to 18-mo) and the planned capacity uplift (+35% burst capacity). Once we have alignment there, we can lock the QBR slot and push the mutual action plan to DocuSign.

Quick proposed next steps:
- Please confirm term preference and whether you need an alternative (12 vs 18 months) by EOD Thu (2025-06-05).
- Share two available QBR windows (45–60 min) the week of 6/16 — we’ll send calendar invites.
- We’ll deliver an updated mutual action plan (attached) and a term-change draft for legal review.
- I’ll loop Legal/Security for the SOC2 / retention items you flagged.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, term-change-draft.pdf (starter drafts)

If helpful, we can set a 30-min prep call before the QBR to run through exec-level talking points.

Thanks —
Soojin
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0142

---
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform
From: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@northstar.tech>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@northstar.tech>
Date: 2025-06-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northstar renewal: starter playbook, risk acceptance & QBR windowing

Thanks Soojin —

Appreciate the starter materials. A couple of quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates:
1) Retention / audit logs: we need a 24-month retention window for audit logs in our environment (not just token logs). Is that supported for the Dedicated deployment?
2) SOC2 scope: our security team wants a short note on what’s in-scope for the last audit and whether we have any pending controls.
3) Term: leadership is leaning toward 18 months if we can get a price band and guaranteed burst headroom for Q4. Can you send the pricing delta for 12 vs 18 and what the SLA looks like with the committed uplift?

QBR availability: 6/17 (10–11am PT) or 6/19 (2–3pm PT) both work for the execs.

Looping Priya (Platform Lead) to make sure she’s aligned on the retention ask.

—Alex
Director of ML Platforms, Northstar Tech
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@northstar.tech>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@northstar.tech>
Date: 2025-06-04T08:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northstar renewal: starter playbook, risk acceptance & QBR windowing

Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps: 
- Retention: Dedicated deployments can support 24-month audit log retention. There are two implementation options (long-term cold storage vs. rolling indexed stores); I’ll have Engineering/SRE outline the trade-offs in the prep doc.
- SOC2: Redwood completed SOC2 Type II (CCPA/controls) as of 2024-11. There are no open remediation items relevant to Dedicated customers; I’ll attach the attestation summary in the QBR packet.
- Pricing: I’ve asked David to provide the 12 vs 18-month pricing delta and confirm the SLA language for the committed uplift.

Proposed: lock 6/17 10–11am PT for the QBR. We’ll send a calendar invite with agenda (capacity plan, SOW, mutual action plan, exec signoff items). If that slot changes, flag it and we’ll pivot to 6/19.

I’m prepping an internal one-pager for the QBR that includes the retention options — will share by EOD 6/05.

Thanks —
Soojin
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@northstar.tech>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@northstar.tech>
Date: 2025-06-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northstar renewal: starter playbook, risk acceptance & QBR windowing

Alex / team —

Attaching the SOW-draft.pdf and a short pricing summary. High level: moving to an 18-month term nets a ~9% unit discount on committed compute with the negotiated burst headroom included in the commitment (details in the attached pricing summary). SLA: 99.9% uptime with an availability-based credit schedule; the draft includes an explicit burst-handling escalation path for Q4 peak windows.

DocuSign: I’ll prepare the mutual action plan for signature once we align on term + capacity. Please expect a DocuSign link after the QBR for the MOU — provisional link below: 
https://app.docusign.com/links/NS-2025-RENEW-42

Security follow-up: Irene, can you provide the SOC2 attestation excerpt and a short note on retention implementation options (cold storage vs. indexed logs) before Friday?

Thanks —
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf
From: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@northstar.tech>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@northstar.tech>
Date: 2025-06-06T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northstar renewal: starter playbook, risk acceptance & QBR windowing

All —

Thanks, that looks good. We’ll take the 18-month path pending the finalized pricing & SLA language in the SOW. 6/17 10–11am PT is confirmed for the QBR.

Please include in the QBR packet:
- Short one-pager on retention implementation choices and expected timeline to enable 24-month logs.
- Pricing delta table (12 vs 18) and a walked example of monthly spend at current usage + 35% uplift.
- Exec-level summary of SOC2 scope and attestation page.

See you on 6/17.

—Alex
